description: EPDK: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by EPDK. Coverage: EPDK. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Bölge Bazlı Elektrik Tüketimi; Dağıtım Bölgelerine Göre Elektrik Abone Sayısı; Elektrik Tüketici Türünün Türkiye Bazında Dağılımının Karşılaştırılmas; Tüketici Türüne Göre Elektrik Tüketimi. Formats seen: CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
